Resets unlocks, collection, sets and tok.lua: Setzt Freischaltungen, Sammlung, Sets und Tokens zurück. Optionen bleiben.
Resets unlocks, collection, sets and tok.unity: Setzt Freischaltungen, Sammlung, Sets und Tokens zurück.

loaded.lua: Heads: 4 gold. Tails: lose up to 8 gold. Edge: lose up to 4, then gain 2 gold.

blood.lua: Heads: 10 points. Tails: quota +6. Edge: half of both.
blood.unity: Big points, but Tails raises the quota.

focus.lua: Heads: the next coin gets +35% Heads. Tails: 4 points.

snowball.lua: Heads gains +1 point every flip for the whole run (max +8).
snowball.unity: Grows +1 point every flip for the whole run (max +10).

blood_pact.lua: Heads: next Blood coin gains 8 points on Heads or adds 4 quota on Tails. Edge gets half of both.
blood_pact.unity: Heads: next Blood coin gains 8 points on Heads or adds 4 quota on Tails.

doppelganger.lua: Heads: next Chaos coin applies its resolved effects twice, including penalties.
doppelganger.unity: Heads: next Chaos coin applies its resolved effects twice.

flock.lua: +10% Heads for every other Flock in your deck.
flock.unity: +10% Heads for every other Flock in your bank.

pot.lua: Heads: points equal to the flips made so far this level (max 8).
pot.unity: Heads: points equal to the flips made so far this level (max 12).

cash_out.lua: Heads: 3 points, squares the combo multiplier, banks its pot, then resets the combo.
cash_out.unity: Heads: 3 points, the combo multiplier counts twice, then the combo resets.

amplifier.lua: Heads: 1 point. Active buffs last 1 coin longer; odds and multipliers grow stronger. Tails: 1 point.
amplifier.unity: Heads: 1 point, and all active buffs last 1 coin longer and get stronger. Tails: 1 point.

doubler.lua: Heads: 3 points, doubled for every Doubler flip so far this level (3, 6, 12, 24... up to 384).
doubler.unity: Heads: 3 points, doubled for every Doubler flip so far this level (3, 6, 12, 24...).

mimic.lua: Heads: does what the Heads side of a random other coin in your deck does.
mimic.unity: Heads: copies the Heads effects of a random other coin in your deck.

good_dog.lua: Heads: 2 points; return the highest-scoring coin played this level to the draw pile. Once per level.
good_dog.unity: Heads: 2 points; return the highest-scoring coin played this level once.

orchestra.lua: Heads: 2 points per different coin type in your deck.
orchestra.unity: Heads: 2 points per different coin in your deck.

conductor.lua: Heads: next 3 Rhythm coins gain 2 points per combo step (max 8); a broken combo adds 5 quota.
conductor.unity: Heads: next 3 Rhythm coins gain points from the combo.

lifeline.lua: Heads: 1 point, and you may exchange one more time this level.
lifeline.unity: Heads: 1 point, and one extra exchange this level.

horoscope.lua: Heads: 1 point, all coins +7% Heads this level. Tails: all coins +3%.
horoscope.unity: Heads: 1 point, all coins +7% Heads this level. Tails: +3%.
